name: canon
description: Deterministic local/tailnet typesetting builder, verifier, store, and server for sealed HTML + Markdown editions.

scripts.build:golden: node src/cli.mjs build fixtures/report/phase1-review.report.json --out dist/golden --receipt dist/golden.build-receipt.json
scripts.brief:fixture: node src/cli.mjs brief fixtures/report/phase1-review.report.json --store dist/review-store --alias phase1-review
scripts.service:start: node src/cli.mjs service start --root dist/review-store --state-dir dist/service
scripts.service:start:tailscale: node src/cli.mjs service start --root dist/review-store --state-dir dist/service --tailscale
scripts.service:clean: node src/cli.mjs service clean --state-dir dist/service --store dist/review-store
